opening.argument: The central discussion is Bitcoin cycle analysis, not a promise of financial returns. The speaker places Bitcoin halfway through a bear market under a four-year cycle trend, then expressly says that cyclical evidence cannot support strong concrete predictions and that price predictions are speculative. The Bitunix promotion is separately identifiable: the speaker offers a 15% lifetime trading-fee discount for signing up through his link and acknowledges a partnership deal. The description and exchange page also present rewards and signup controls. Those features show a promotional pathway, but the supplied material does not establish deception, undisclosed conditions, or any completed transaction. The market commentary remains qualified opinion, while the referral offer is disclosed as a partnership.
